messages:
Avi: Quick greenroom sweep — can we lock the launch blog hero + three proof bullets + CTAs and bench copy in the next hour? Need HubSpot hidden fields and a demo slot pinned.
Sasha: I got hero + social headline. Will drop three micro-variants in the doc in 10.
Ren: I'll take benchmarks and the short chart caption. Plan to state median + p95; will include one-line test context (hw + avg seq).
Noah: Ops check 1: we have an open demo pod at 16:00 PT and another at 20:00 PT. Recommend 16:00 for press overlap. I can pin whichever you want.
Avi: Primary CTA: "Register for launch demo". Secondary CTA: "Request a dedicated eval" (legal qualifier needed). Also need a one-sentence media blurb for partner syndication.
Sasha: Drafts uploaded: https://docs.google.com/abc - chosen hero = short punchy line (variant 2). Social alt: "Predictable LLM latency, fewer surprises."
Ren: Bench draft: "median latency up to 3.3x faster and p95 up to 1.9x in our internal benchmarks." Test note: "tests run on 1x A100-equivalent; mixed batch; avg seq ~128; perf-harness:v2." Keeping language conservative per legal.
Bea (Legal): Quick guidance: use "up to" and add "in our internal benchmarks". Approve that wording. For the eval CTA add "(subject to qualification)". I can do a final pass in 45m. Avoid absolute words like "always", "guarantee", "best".
Noah: Calendly: pinned 16:00 PT demo, updated event title to "Redwood Launch Demo". RSVP flow tested; confirmation email good.
Sasha: HubSpot hidden fields for copy/paste:
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: greenroom_launch_v1
  demo_slot: 16:00
  lead_route: launch_inbound
```
Sasha: Routing rules: utm_campaign=greenroom_launch_v1 -> assign to queue "launch-inbound"; company_size>200 -> enterprise funnel. Also set sf_tag: "launch_interest".
Avi: Nice. Two last asks: (1) Ren, add the perf-harness repo and exact batch mix line. (2) Sasha, include an alt headline for LinkedIn.
Ren: Done 10m ago - added repo link (github.com/redwood/perf-harness v2) and note: "batch mix: 60% short, 40% medium; avg seq 128".
Sasha: LinkedIn alt: "Ship inference you can measure  predictable latency and unit cost."
Bea (Legal): Reviewed doc and left sign-off comment. Bench phrasing approved and CTAs ok with qualifier.
DeployBot: Automated: publish checklist uploaded -> /playbooks/publish-checklist.pdf :white_check_mark:
Avi: OK locking CTAs: primary = "Register for launch demo"; secondary = "Request a dedicated eval (subject to qualification)". Proposed publish window = tomorrow 10:30am PT. If no objections by 4:30pm today I'll schedule the publish and queue social for +2m. :rocket:
Noah: I'll run a final end-to-end HubSpot test after scheduling to confirm routing and SF flags.
Sasha: Leaving one tiny alt hero for post-publish A/B.
Avi: Thanks team  closing this sweep.
